ORDER_PENDING.title: A new order is waiting for confirmation
ORDER_PENDING.body: An order is waiting for you to confirm the payment.

ORDER_CONFIRMED.title: Your order was confirmed
ORDER_CONFIRMED.body: Your order was confirmed. You can start learning now.

ORDER_REJECTED.title: Your order was not confirmed
ORDER_REJECTED.body: Your order was not confirmed. Reason: {{reason}}

PLAN_EXPIRING.title: Your plan is about to expire
PLAN_EXPIRING.body: Your plan expires in about 7 days.

PLAN_EXPIRED.title: Your plan has expired
PLAN_EXPIRED.body: Your plan has expired. Renew it to keep learning.

SCORE_PRELIMINARY.title: A preliminary score is ready
SCORE_PRELIMINARY.body: The preliminary (AI) score of your attempt is ready. The official score will follow.

SCORE_OFFICIAL.title: Your official score is ready
SCORE_OFFICIAL.body: The official score of your attempt is ready. Open the result to review your answers.

GRADING_QUEUE_NEW.title: A new submission is in the grading queue
GRADING_QUEUE_NEW.body: A new submission is waiting for a teacher to grade it.

GRADING_CLAIM_DUE.title: A submission you claimed is almost overdue
GRADING_CLAIM_DUE.body: A submission you claimed is about to pass its grading deadline. Grade it or release it back to the queue.

REVIEW_REQUESTED.title: Content is waiting for review
REVIEW_REQUESTED.body: A content item ({{contentType}}) of the {{examCode}} exam is waiting for your review.

REVIEW_CHANGES_REQUESTED.title: Changes were requested on your content
REVIEW_CHANGES_REQUESTED.body: The reviewer asked you to change a content item ({{contentType}}) of the {{examCode}} exam.

CONTENT_PUBLISHED.title: Your content was published
CONTENT_PUBLISHED.body: The content item ({{contentType}}) of the {{examCode}} exam that you wrote was approved and published.

ASSIGNMENT_NEW.title: You have a new assignment
ASSIGNMENT_NEW.body: Your teacher just gave you a new assignment. Open your assignments to see the due date.

ASSIGNMENT_DUE_SOON.title: An assignment is due soon
ASSIGNMENT_DUE_SOON.body: One of your assignments is about to be due.

SESSION_REMINDER.title: A class starts soon
SESSION_REMINDER.body: Your class starts in about 1 hour.

AI_GRADING_FAILED.title: AI grading failed
AI_GRADING_FAILED.body: AI grading of an attempt failed after every retry. An administrator needs to look at it.
